title: Angi vs Thumbtack: Which Platform is Best for Your Business?

facts.fact: The article states that Angi offers listings for around 720 specific home improvement and repair services.
facts.quote: The platform offers listings for around 720 specific home improvement and repair services, allowing you to connect directly with customers

facts.fact: The article states that Thumbtack covers more than 900 unique services across 13 distinct industries.
facts.quote: Covering more than **900 unique services across 13 distinct industries**, Thumbtack goes beyond home services

facts.fact: The article states that Angi is free to join, but businesses are charged fees to advertise their services and become more visible in customer searches.
facts.quote: While it is free to join Angi, businesses are charged fees to advertise their services and become more visible in customer searches.

facts.fact: The article states that Angi has no flat annual fee for basic functionalities and that its advertising pricing is negotiable based on advertising needs.
facts.quote: Angi’s pricing model is negotiable based on your advertising needs, and there is no flat annual fee for basic functionalities.

facts.fact: The article states that Thumbtack uses a credit system in which professionals buy credits to communicate with leads.
facts.quote: Thumbtack uses a **credit system**, where professionals buy credits to communicate with leads

facts.fact: The article states that Thumbtack's lead cost is a number of credits that varies by job complexity, demand, and location, and that the system is pay-as-you-go with no annual flat fee.
facts.quote: Each lead costs a certain number of credits, which can vary depending on the job’s complexity, demand, and location.
